steps.name: [GATE] Destructive migration lint — new SQL dropping data needs a plan file
steps.run:
BASE="origin/${BASE_BRANCH}"
NEW_SQL=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A "$BASE"...HEAD -- 'drizzle/*.sql' || true)
[ -z "$NEW_SQL" ] && { echo "no new migrations"; exit 0; }
FAIL=0
for f in $NEW_SQL; do
  if grep -inE '^\s*(DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+COLUMN|TRUNCATE)|ALTER\s+TABLE\s+\S+\s+DROP\s' "$f"; then
    PLAN="docs/verification/migration-plans/$(basename "$f" .sql).md"
    if [ ! -f "$PLAN" ]; then
      echo "::error file=$f::destructive statement without approved plan $PLAN"
      FAIL=1
    fi
  fi
done
exit $FAIL

steps.name: [GATE] AI-surface governed manifests — repo-side checksum re-verify
steps.run:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path("ml/dime-1.0/evidence/manifests/phase1-observability-closure-v1")
closure = json.loads((root / "closure.json").read_text())
bad, notes = [], []
for e in closure["evidence"]:
    p = Path(e["artifact"])
    inside_ml = e["artifact"].startswith("ml/")
    if not p.is_file():
        # A missing artifact breaks the closure regardless of tree.
        bad.append(f"MISSING {e['artifact']}"); continue
    h = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if h != e["sha256"]:
        if inside_ml:
            # Governed evidence tree is immutable — drift blocks.
            bad.append(
                f"DRIFT {e['artifact']} pinned={e['sha256'][:12]} actual={h[:12]}"
            )
        else:
            # Out-of-tree artifacts (drizzle/schema.ts, server tests,
            # package.json) are POINT-IN-TIME references: the closure
            # proves what they were when the evidence was frozen, but
            # they legitimately evolve (2026-08-05: #370's lockout
            # migration changed drizzle/schema.ts and correctly so —
            # schema rides db-push law, not evidence law). Drift here
            # is informational; existence stays mandatory.
            notes.append(
                f"note: out-of-tree reference evolved since closure: "
                f"{e['artifact']} pinned={e['sha256'][:12]} actual={h[:12]}"
            )
for line in (root / "SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines():
    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
    h = hashlib.sha256((root / rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if h != digest:
        bad.append(f"SUMS-DRIFT {rel}")
for n in notes:
    print(n)
if bad:
    print("\n".join(bad)); sys.exit(1)
print(f"{len(closure['evidence'])} evidence pins verified "
      f"({len(notes)} out-of-tree references noted) + SHA256SUMS verified")
EOF

steps.name: Enforce the arming gate against live production posture
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
# `|| status=$?`, not a bare call followed by `$?`: GitHub runs `run:`
# blocks under `bash -e`, so a bare failing call would abort the step
# before the remedy text below could be printed. Consuming the failure
# with `||` suppresses -e while still capturing the exit code, and the
# step still ends with `exit "$status"` — the gate's verdict, unaltered.
status=0
node scripts/edge-arming-gate.mjs enforce \
  --origin="$ORIGIN" \
  --record=docs/runbooks/edge-arming-authorization.json || status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::Edge arming gate FAILED. Either production is armed without a"
  echo "::error::qualifying soak authorization, or its posture could not be read."
  echo "::error::Remedy A (always available, never gated): set EDGE_MODE=log."
  echo "::error::Remedy B: run a >=60min log-mode soak, then"
  echo "::error::  node scripts/edge-arming-gate.mjs authorize --evidence=... --origin=\$ORIGIN"
  echo "::error::and land the record through a reviewed PR."
fi
exit "$status"

if [ ! -f docs/runbooks/edge-arming-authorization.json ]; then
  echo "no authorization record committed — nothing to validate."
  echo "(absence is not a failure here: an un-armed production needs no record;"
  echo " the enforce job is what refuses an ARMED production without one.)"
  exit 0
fi
node scripts/edge-arming-gate.mjs validate \
  --record=docs/runbooks/edge-arming-authorization.json

[INPUT] Checkout main (full history — the appender reads merge parents)
[VERIFY] os-ledger must not be main — a deploy here would be a defect

steps.name: [STEP] Append the cycle artifact to the os-ledger orphan branch
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
SHA="${GITHUB_SHA}"
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

# Materialise os-ledger in a worktree; create it orphan on first run.
if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin os-ledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git fetch origin os-ledger --depth=1
  git worktree add /tmp/osl origin/os-ledger --detach
  git -C /tmp/osl checkout -B os-ledger
else
  git worktree add --detach /tmp/osl
  git -C /tmp/osl checkout --orphan os-ledger
  git -C /tmp/osl rm -rf . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '# os-ledger\n\nMachine-generated loop artifacts. Never deployed: Railway pins main.\n' > /tmp/osl/README.md
fi

# Resolve the proof-contract run for this merge.
#
# DEFECT FIXED 2026-08-05: the first version matched on GITHUB_SHA, the
# MERGE commit. 01-pr-proof-contract runs on `pull_request`, so its
# headSha is the PR HEAD, never the merge commit -- the lookup matched
# nothing and every artifact recorded proofContractRunId: null. Caught
# by inspecting the very first artifact the loop produced.
#
# Correct chain: merge commit -> PR number -> PR head sha -> run.
PRNUM=$(git log -1 --format=%s "$SHA" | sed -n 's/^Merge pull request #\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
RID=""
if [ -n "$PRNUM" ]; then
  PRHEAD=$(gh pr view "$PRNUM" --json headRefOid --jq '.headRefOid' 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PRHEAD" ]; then
    RID=$(gh run list --workflow=01-pr-proof-contract.yml --limit 60 \
            --json databaseId,headSha,conclusion --jq \
            "[.[]|select(.headSha==\"$PRHEAD\" and .conclusion==\"success\")][0].databaseId // empty" \
            2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
fi
echo "[os-ledger] pr=${PRNUM:-none} head=${PRHEAD:-none} proofContractRun=${RID:-none}"

cd /tmp/osl
PROOF_CONTRACT_RUN_ID="${RID}" node "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/scripts/os/ledger-append.mjs" \
  --sha "$SHA" --repo "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"

if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  git add -A
  git commit -q -m "os-ledger: cycle for ${SHA:0:12}"
  git push -q origin os-ledger
  echo "[os-ledger] pushed"
else
  echo "[os-ledger] no change (idempotent replay)"
fi

echo "===== [MLB] games coverage by sport × date ====="

          COUNT(*) AS games,
          SUM(modelRunAt IS NOT NULL) AS with_model,
          FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(modelRunAt)/1000) AS last_model_run_utc,
          SUM(mlAwayMoneyPct IS NOT NULL) AS with_splits
   FROM games
   WHERE gameDate IN ($IN_LIST)
   GROUP BY sport, gameDate ORDER BY gameDate, sport;"

echo "===== [MLB] sample: first 5 games for the dates (model vs book) ====="
M "SELECT id, gameDate, sport, awayTeam, homeTeam,
          modelRunAt IS NOT NULL AS modeled,
          awayModelSpread, awayBookSpread, modelTotal, bookTotal
   FROM games WHERE gameDate IN ($IN_LIST) AND sport='MLB'
   ORDER BY gameDate, id LIMIT 5;"

echo "===== [WC] wc2026_matches by date (team resolution) ====="
M "SELECT match_date,
          COUNT(*) AS matches,
          SUM(home_team_id<>'tbd' AND away_team_id<>'tbd') AS resolved_teams
   FROM wc2026_matches
   WHERE match_date IN ($IN_LIST)
   GROUP BY match_date ORDER BY match_date;"

echo "===== [WC] match rows for the dates ====="
M "SELECT match_id, match_date, stage, home_team_id, away_team_id, kickoff_utc
   FROM wc2026_matches WHERE match_date IN ($IN_LIST) ORDER BY kickoff_utc;"

echo "===== [WC] odds snapshot + model-projection presence for those matches ====="
M "SELECT
     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wc2026_odds_snapshots o
        JOIN wc2026_matches m ON m.match_id=o.match_id
        WHERE m.match_date IN ($IN_LIST)) AS odds_snapshots,
     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wc2026_model_projections p
        JOIN wc2026_matches m ON m.match_id=p.match_id
        WHERE m.match_date IN ($IN_LIST)) AS model_projections;"

steps.name: Probe public feed endpoints
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
base="${ORIGIN%/}"
stamp() { date -u +%FT%TZ; }

# tRPC httpBatchLink GET: /api/trpc/<proc>?batch=1&input=<urlenc {"0":{"json":<input>}}>
enc() { jq -rn --arg s "$1" '$s|@uri'; }
batch_input() { printf '{"0":{"json":%s}}' "$1"; }

probe() {
  local label="$1" proc="$2" json="$3"
  local input; input="$(batch_input "$json")"
  local url; url="$base/api/trpc/$proc?batch=1&input=$(enc "$input")"
  echo "---- $label : $proc  @ $(stamp) ----"
  local hdr body code
  hdr="$(mktemp)"; body="$(mktemp)"
  code="$(curl -sS -D "$hdr" -o "$body" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 45 "$url" 2>&1)" || code="ERR"
  echo "HTTP $code"
  grep -i '^x-games-count:' "$hdr" || true
  grep -i '^x-cache-status:' "$hdr" || true
  local n; n=$(wc -c < "$body")
  echo "body_bytes=$n"
  # Field-presence signals (counts, never values):
  # modelRunAt is a numeric bigint (epoch ms) or null — count both correctly.
  echo "modelRunAt_number=$(grep -o '\"modelRunAt\":[0-9]' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "modelRunAt_null=$(grep -o '\"modelRunAt\":null' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "edge_tags=$(grep -o '\[EDGE\]' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "modelTotal_fields=$(grep -o '\"modelTotal\"' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "splits_fields=$(grep -o 'BetsPct\|MoneyPct\|ticketsPct\|moneyPct' "$body" | wc -l)"
  # WC-specific signals: Double Chance appears once per side (dkOdds=book,
  # modelOdds=model), so N matches with both book AND model DC → 2N counts.
  echo "wc_homeDrawOdds=$(grep -o '\"homeDrawOdds\":-\?[0-9]' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "wc_awayDrawOdds=$(grep -o '\"awayDrawOdds\":-\?[0-9]' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "wc_noDraw=$(grep -o '\"noDraw\":-\?[0-9]' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "wc_dkOdds_objs=$(grep -o '\"dkOdds\":{' "$body" | wc -l)"
  echo "wc_modelOdds_objs=$(grep -o '\"modelOdds\":{' "$body" | wc -l)"
  # WC winner-scope verification (owner directive 2026-07-18): the
  # model winner odds (model_*_to_advance → modelOdds.toAdvance*) are
  # public display data already served to every visitor — extract
  # matchId → home/away team ids → book+model toAdvance and 3-way ML
  # per match so the winner-market binding can be verified end-to-end
  # from CI (the sandboxed agent container has no egress to prod).
  echo "wc_winner_scope=$(jq -c '(.[0].result.data.json // []) | if type=="array" then map({id:.matchId, home:.homeTeamId, away:.awayTeamId, bookAdvH:(.dkOdds.toAdvanceHome // null), bookAdvA:(.dkOdds.toAdvanceAway // null), modelAdvH:(.modelOdds.toAdvanceHome // null), modelAdvA:(.modelOdds.toAdvanceAway // null), modelH:(.modelOdds.home // null), modelD:(.modelOdds.draw // null), modelA:(.modelOdds.away // null)}) else "not-a-match-array" end' "$body" 2>/dev/null || echo 'jq-parse-failed')"
  echo "wc_venueIds=$(grep -o '\"venueId\":\"[a-z0-9-]*\"' "$body" | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ')"
  # First 500 bytes for shape sanity (public data only):
  echo "head: $(head -c 500 "$body" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  echo
}

echo "=================== P0 FEED VERIFY @ $(stamp) ==================="
echo "ORIGIN: $base"
if [ -n "${PROC:-}" ]; then
  probe "ad-hoc" "$PROC" "${INPUT_JSON:-null}"
else
  probe "current date"       "games.getCurrentDate" "null"
  probe "last refresh"       "games.lastRefresh"    "null"
  probe "MLB 07-10"          "games.list"           '{"sport":"MLB","gameDate":"2026-07-10"}'
  probe "MLB 07-11"          "games.list"           '{"sport":"MLB","gameDate":"2026-07-11"}'
  probe "MLB splits"         "games.liveSplits"     "null"
  probe "WC today+odds"      "wc2026.todayWithOdds" "null"
  probe "WC by date 07-11"   "wc2026.matchesByDate" '{"date":"2026-07-11"}'
fi
echo "=================== END ==================="
